title: Geometric Latent Space Quantum State Tomography with Metric-Preserving Autoencoders: Source Code
description: Code, held-out test sets, trained models and result files for the revised version of the paper Geometric Latent Space Quantum State Tomography with Metric-Preserving Autoencoders (Machine Learning: Science and Technology, under review). The folder revision/ reproduces every table and figure of the revised paper; legacy/ keeps the code and outputs of the first submitted version, which is also archived as version 1 of this work.
